About the author (2021)

Eric Berger is a reporter and editor based in Houston. After a long career in the Houston Chronicle, he joined Ars Technica in 2015 as the site’s senior space editor, covering SpaceX, NASA, and everything beyond. He was a Pulitzer Prize finalist for his coverage of Hurricane Ike in the Houston Chronicle in 2008.

As the senior space editor at Ars , Berger's primary focus is on NASA and private aerospace companies . [ 3 ] [ 6 ] Berger authored Liftoff , which was published by William Morrow and Company and released in March 2021. [ 10 ] [ 11 ] The book chronicles the early history of SpaceX and the protracted development program of the Falcon 1 launch vehicle. [ 12 ] He released a sequel in 2024, Reentry , that details the rise of the company through the first Falcon 9 launch, the development of the Dragon capsule, the inaugural Falcon Heavy launch, and the company's first human spaceflight. [ 13 ]
